repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-avatar
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.avatar that resolves Webex users to avatar URLs. retrieveAvatarUrl(user, options) turns a uuid, email, or user object into a uuid through webex.internal.user.asUUID, answers from an in-memory store keyed by uuid and size, and on a miss requests the asked size plus every configured size (40, 50, 80, 110, 135, 192, 640, 1600; default 80) through a batcher that groups lookups into one POST profiles/urls to the avatar service; entries expire after cacheControl seconds (3600 by default), and hideDefaultAvatar makes a default avatar resolve null. setAvatar(file) resizes the image with @webex/helper-image, uploads it as the current user's avatar through the three-phase webex-core upload to profile sessions of the avatar service, clears that user's cached sizes, and resolves the new URL. Nothing is persisted.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-avatar package entry
public_interfaces.audience: first-party Webex clients and the SDK packages that register it
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports the user and device plugins, then registers Avatar as internal plugin 'avatar' with the avatar config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export Avatar is the only export; config is not exported.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.avatar methods
public_interfaces.notes: retrieveAvatarUrl resolves a URL string, or null when options.hideDefaultAvatar is set and the avatar is a default one; options.size defaults to 80 and options.cacheControl to 3600 seconds, filled only where undefined and written into the caller's object. A miss prefetches every configured size, and one missing size rejects the call with 'Failed to retrieve avatar'. setAvatar uploads the helper-image thumbnail of the file for the current user and resolves the finalize url; it rejects with a TypeError for a non-image. The store, the batcher child, and the underscore-prefixed fetch helpers are reachable but not supported entries.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: build runs build:src, which writes dist. test:unit runs the jest unit specs, which import the package by name and so test dist; run build:src first. test:browser (commands.browser-test) runs karma over test/integration/spec but bundles nothing today (0 tests, exit 0), and its one spec has every case commented out. The aggregate test script runs test:style and test:unit, then exits 1 because test:integration is not defined; it is deliberately not a manifest command.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call webex.request for profiles/urls outside the batcher.
negative_guidance.why: Lookups must be de-duplicated and grouped so a burst sends one request per flush (INV-002).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change config.sizes without changing the fixed size list in AvatarUrlStore.remove.
negative_guidance.why: setAvatar invalidation would leave sizes cached until their TTL (module spec Pitfalls).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not read the service cacheControl field for the TTL without updating INV-001.
negative_guidance.why: The store TTL comes from options.cacheControl or config.cacheControl by design (config comment).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log user ids, emails, or avatar URLs.
negative_guidance.why: They identify users; the only log line today prints sizes only.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as a usage reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its Usage block names a placeholder member; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.
